question: Nowadays, more and more women decide to have children later in their life. What are the reasons for this? Do the advantages of this outweigh disadvantages?
essay:
These days, an increasing number of women give birth later in their life. This can be attributed to multiple factors, which will be analyzed in the essay below, together with the reasons why I assert that the drawbacks outweigh the benefits significantly.

There are two reasons why women delay childbirth. The most striking one is that females place greater emphasis on professional and academic advancements, on the grounds that they are influenced by modern thoughts and lifestyles that ladies should prioritize personal freedom and career development, they devote themselves to their work or study in pursuit of financial independence to provide a prosperity life or ensure the best future for their kids. This can be exemplified by many Korean people afraid of having children hindering them in climbing the career ladder, so they tend to choose to remain a child-free couple for a long time, or even decide not to have children at all. In addition to this, their social status is more and more recognized as it is synonymous with having social power, individuals can access better opportunities in education, finance, and relationships.

From my perspective, more adults hesitate about having offspring will bring adversely negative impacts. One of them is that not only the mother but also the baby is at an elevated risk of health issues. For instance, a woman gets married beyond the age of 30 giving rise to the rate of congenital deformity or delivery complications, there is a high probability that the baby is prone to suffer from autism, ADHD, down syndrome in a worst-case scenario. Besides, having kids in ageing life puts a burden on a state, by virtue of an aging population leading to the shortage of a young and energetic workforce, this will obstruct economic growth and impede technological innovations.

In conclusion, the fact that women postpone having a child is caused by many reasons. From my point of view, I believe that it is a disadvantageous development in general.
